verdict.rationale: Sai is Simular's built-in AI agent. You hand it tasks in plain English and it completes them by operating desktop and web apps [simular-gh-1, simular-docs-24, simular-docs-17]. It runs on its own cloud machine, keeps going after you close the laptop, can be commanded from your phone, sends notifications when it needs you, and asks for approval before sensitive actions [simular-docs-23, simular-docs-16, simular-docs-22]. It also replays saved workflows on a schedule, and you can watch it work as it runs [simular-docs-14, simular-docs-15]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, since all evidence is vendor-authored.
